sources.title: GitHub - m87-labs/kestrel
sources.snippet: Kestrel High-performance inference engine for vision-language models. Kestrel is the inference engine behind Photon, Moondream's on-device deployment option. Most Moondream users should install via pip install moondream; this repository provides the engine directly and supports additional model families.
